author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX is preparing to conduct a Wet Dress Rehearsal ahead of Flight 14. Booster 21 was first to Pad 2, soon followed by Ship 41, as SpaceX continues to target September 28, pending regulatory approval.
